Introducing GLM-5.3: Built to Code. Ready for Cyber Defense.

- Top-tier coding and agentic capabilities, achieved through post-training on the 743B base model
- A major leap in cybersecurity, setting a new standard among open models

Tech Blog: https://t.co/ekQkO83jCv https://t.co/y3Y2AB0wxr

Introducing GLM-5.3-Flash

- Leading capabilities at a highly competitive price
- Natively multimodal with a 1M-token context window
- A 320B-A18B model released under the MIT License
- Previously previewed as Ox Alpha, running entirely on Chinese AI chips

Blog: https://t.co/tzOmB7gdZP

source: Retained publisher announcements, discussion posts and OpenRouter daily ranking. The replay constructs the release finding locally.

preview_report.text:
Ox Alpha (a stealth model) just dropped on OpenCode, and it’s probably a GLM model, most likely an AIR variant.

Free for the next week with 1M context, multimodal support, zero data retention and near-unlimited usage.

I put it against DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.3 on the same Three.js prompt:

“Create a stylized sakura tree in bloom with drifting petals and soft spring lighting.”

I’ll post more side-by-side comparisons in the replies.
